issues.title: DQN-10 Complete community health files and repository cross-links
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-10

Add `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` and `SECURITY.md`, then cross-link the repository health files from README and CONTRIBUTING so contributors can find the canonical policy entry points quickly.

issues.title: DQN-11 Generate GitHub release notes from the matching CHANGELOG section
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-11

Automate release-note generation from the changelog section that matches the tag or version being released. Keep the output aligned with the repository's existing release cadence and changelog wording.

issues.title: DQN-14 Unify policy for repo-local scripts across CI, Sonar, and ignore rules
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-14

Define one consistent policy for repo-local helper scripts across CI workflows, Sonar configuration, and ignore rules. Document which scripts are supported, which are intentionally local-only, and how they should be excluded or enforced.

issues.title: DQN-15 Align `tuning_test.py` with the chosen CI and coverage policy
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-15

Align `tuning_test.py` with the selected CI surface and coverage policy so its role is explicit. Either make it part of an enforced path with stable expectations or document why it remains outside the protected test slice.

issues.title: DQN-18 Enforce a coverage threshold in CI and/or Sonar quality gates
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-18

Enforce a repository coverage threshold in CI and/or Sonar using the existing `pytest-cov` reporting flow. The gate should fail predictably when coverage drops below the agreed baseline.

issues.title: DQN-22 Lint GitHub Actions workflows with actionlint
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-22

Add `actionlint` to the repository workflow validation path so malformed GitHub Actions changes are caught before merge. Keep the lint entry point easy to run locally and in CI.

issues.title: DQN-23 Review and refresh the SonarQube scan action pin beyond v7.2.1
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-23

Review the pinned SonarQube scan action version and refresh it beyond `v7.2.1` if a supported update is available. Capture any compatibility or security implications in the change notes.

issues.title: DQN-16 Expand wrapper coverage for Atari and CNN preprocessing paths
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-16

Extend the existing wrapper tests to cover Atari-specific preprocessing, frame stacking, and CNN-ready observation handling. Focus on deterministic edge cases that can silently break downstream training behavior.
issues.milestone: 3.2.x Test Depth for CNN & Wrapper Paths

issues.title: DQN-17 Expand CNN model tests beyond forward-pass smoke coverage
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-17

Build on the current CNN smoke coverage with stronger assertions for tensor shapes, dueling head behavior, and supported configuration variants. The goal is to catch architectural regressions before training runs do.
issues.milestone: 3.2.x Test Depth for CNN & Wrapper Paths

issues.title: DQN-19 Add deterministic tests for orthogonal CNN weight initialization
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-19

Add deterministic tests around orthogonal CNN weight initialization so changes to setup code do not silently alter the expected parameter properties. Keep the assertions stable across supported runtime environments.
issues.milestone: 3.2.x Test Depth for CNN & Wrapper Paths

issues.title: DQN-20 Add gradient-flow and backward-pass tests for CNN networks
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-20

Add tests that exercise backward propagation and verify gradients flow through CNN networks under representative inputs. Cover the main training-critical branches instead of relying only on forward-pass validation.
issues.milestone: 3.2.x Test Depth for CNN & Wrapper Paths

issues.title: DQN-13 Implement SumTree-backed prioritized replay sampling
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-13

Replace the current prioritized replay sampling internals with a SumTree-backed implementation while preserving the public buffer factory and training integration points. The new path should improve sampling efficiency without changing user-facing configuration semantics.

issues.title: DQN-21 Create reproducible CPU/GPU forward-pass benchmarks for CNN inference
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: DQN-21

Create reproducible CPU and GPU forward-pass benchmarks for CNN inference so architectural and environment changes can be compared on a stable baseline. Store outputs in a form that can be diffed across runs.

issues.title: FE-2 Persist experiment metadata manifests next to models and metrics
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: FE-2

Persist machine-readable experiment manifests next to generated models and metrics so runs can be reproduced and compared without manual log inspection. Capture the minimum metadata needed to trace configuration, environment, and artifact lineage.

issues.title: FE-1 Add a Transformer-based Q-network backend as a new `network_type`
issues.body:
Original backlog IDs: FE-1

Add a Transformer-based Q-network backend as a new `network_type` alongside the existing `mlp` and `cnn` options. Keep the implementation aligned with the current config and factory patterns so future backends remain composable.
